preview.text: United States of America play Namibia at Grand Prairie Stadium. In 11 recorded one-day meetings, United States of America have won 8 and Namibia 3. Sides batting first here usually make about 213 (8 recorded one-day matches). Namibia won the toss and chose to bowl first. summary.text: USA scored 277 for 7 in their innings, led by Shehan Jayasuriya with 76 off 99 balls, while Bernard Scholtz took 2 for 39. Namibia chased the target by finishing at 278 for 4, thanks to Louren Steenkamp who scored 102 off 114 balls as Harmeet Singh claimed 1 for 44. Namibia won the match by 6 wickets.
